topic: Language with the most native speakers in India
core_question: Which language has the most native speakers in India? (secondary: Who directed the 1999 science fiction film The Matrix?)
answer_summary: The answer must name Hindi as the language with the most native speakers in India.; after the topic shift: Accept 'the Wachowskis' (Lana and Lilly Wachowski, credited at release as the Wachowski Brothers) — co-directors of The Matrix (1999).
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: So I'm working on this thing about languages in India and I'm trying to remember which one has the most native speakers??? I know I learned this once but my brain is just fried. Do you know which one it is?

Yeah I know there's loads of them. But which one specifically has like the MOST? Just tell me that one.

If you picture India's geography, which regions do you think have the largest populations? When you think of India's northern areas versus southern areas, do you recall them speaking the same language or different ones? What would help a language become the "most native" one—would it be spoken in more regions, or by more people in one big region?
